|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 3). The image here is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-129-Nick_Of_Time.png]]). The current text is [[Nick Of Time (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), the Master List of 27 April 2013.

* '''PC-E1''' ([[Nick Of Time (V) (Errata)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-L-nickoftime-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date-Virtual2-Light">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual2-Light/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034559/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Light/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>: “Deploy on table. Dack Ralter and Wes Janson have [Pilot] 2. During your control phase, may ▲ one Attack Pattern Delta, Desperate Tactics, Lucky Shot, One More Pass, Rapid Fire, or a vehicle weapon. May lose 2 Force to cancel Trample or Walker Barrage. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' nothing: the card image prints the release-sheet words again, word for word. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date). Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and set mark) and prints slip number “129” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Nick Of Time (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 26)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=26 Internet Archive]</ref>, slip [[:File:VL-history-1220-129-front-master.png]]: “Deploy on table. Dack Ralter and Wes Janson have [Pilot] 2. During your control phase, may ▲ one Attack Pattern Delta, Desperate Tactics, Lucky Shot, One More Pass, Rapid Fire, or a vehicle weapon. May lose 2 Force to cancel Trample or Walker Barrage. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' nothing: the Master List prints the release-sheet words again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (versions rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat; whatever was published last is current). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number.
